# Picksaw

> **PICKSAW** is the creative identity of **Amirehsan Ashoori** (Persian: **امیراحسان عاشوری**) — a multidisciplinary creator who brings together technology, design, art, music and storytelling. Rather than focusing on a single medium, Amirehsan builds across whatever helps an idea come to life: websites, 3D worlds, cinematic edits, music and AI-generated concepts. He treats creativity as one connected ecosystem where code, visuals, sound and atmosphere work together.

The flagship website (picksaw.ir) is an immersive WebGL experience — a walkable 3D city with switchable atmospheres (a night thunderstorm, sunrise and sunset in clear and cloudy weather), an animated 3D "P" logo and a holographic ghost card — showcasing premium cinematic website templates (Verda, Lumina, Clarity, Pulse, Aurora, Lumen), a content feed and the Stormblade game.

## Identity

- Creative identity / brand: **PICKSAW (Picksaw)**
- Creator / owner: **Amirehsan Ashoori** (امیراحسان عاشوری; also written Amir Ehsan Ashoori / AmirEhsan Ashoori)
- Role: founder, creative developer, designer and multidisciplinary artist
- Based in: Iran
- Main site: https://picksaw.ir/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/picksawm/
- WhatsApp / phone: https://wa.me/989380215823 (+98 938 021 5823)

## What Amirehsan Ashoori creates

- **Web design & development** — modern websites, interactive landing pages and premium templates focused on visual storytelling, smooth UX and cinematic presentation.
- **3D art & Unreal Engine** — environments, experiments and cinematic scenes; procedural generation, lighting, world-building and real-time rendering.
- **AI art & video** — original artwork, animated concepts, character designs, live wallpapers and visual experiments that combine imagination with technical workflows.
- **Music & sound** — music production, rap/lyric writing, atmosphere-driven composition and sound design as storytelling beyond visuals.
- **Creative coding** — interactive experiences where animation, motion, effects and experimental interfaces make programming part of the art.
- **Branding & visual identity** — visual identities, concepts and creative systems that make projects feel distinctive rather than generic.

## Creative style

Cyberpunk and futuristic worlds; Persian art and cultural influences; cinematic lighting and atmosphere; architecture and minimalism; mystery, masks and symbolic storytelling; black-and-white contrast with selective color; nature mixed with technology. The goal is memorable, emotionally atmospheric experiences rather than following trends.

## Skills & creative areas

Web design, front-end development, UI/UX design, 3D environment creation, Unreal Engine, creative coding, AI art, AI video, digital illustration, motion design, music production, rap & lyric writing, sound design, visual branding, concept development, digital storytelling.
